hints: Start with the smallest thing that can be seen: in `client/src/App.tsx`, add a route for `patients/:id` whose element is a new `PatientRecord` that only shows the id of the address (`useParams`). When **Open record** stops showing "Page not found", you have the route; everything else goes inside the page.

In `PatientRecord`, load the patient in a `useEffect` that depends on the id, with `getPatient(Number(id))`. Keep three outcomes apart: still loading, found, and failed (the 404 is the "Patient not found" case). The title and the two `NavLink`s only appear once the patient was found. Give the Details link the `end` prop, or it will count as current on the Appointments address too, because that address starts with the same text.

Each tab needs its own address under the same page, so that the page (and its loaded patient) stays while the tab changes. Declare the route as `patients/:id/*` and, inside `PatientRecord`, render a nested `<Routes>` with an `index` route for `<PatientDetails patient={patient} />` and a route `appointments` for `<PatientAppointments patient={patient} />`. Use full addresses in the links: `/patients/${patient.id}` and `/patients/${patient.id}/appointments`.
